summary: Frontend-only re-test of the AFB Taxis redesign after the DARK-hero refactor (Vite+React+TS, http://localhost:3000). Verified: dark hero (#0a0a0a) + 3-slide vehicle slideshow with working dots, wave SVG transition to white, hero CTA + phone buttons, navbar dark->white-glass switch at 420px scroll, desktop anchor links (services 1002 / flotte 2088 / zones 3536 / tarifs 4076), i18n FR/EN/AR/ES (dir=rtl for AR, AR phone now renders correctly), 3-step reservation wizard incl. step gating, live Nominatim autocomplete (2 suggestions returned + selection fills the field), WhatsApp/email/submit buttons, graceful red error box on the placeholder-Supabase submit (button returns to idle, not stuck), modal close + body-overflow restore, booking context propagation from Services ('Transferts Aeroports') and Fleet ('Mercedes Classe E') cards, all sections/counts (6 services, 5 fleet cards, 9 zone chips, 6 tarif rows, yellow Advantages with 6 white circle icons, contact-big-phone, footer), scroll-reveal (7/7 .reveal become visible), mobile 390x844 (menu toggle + mobile book button, 2x2 stats grid 178px/178px, tarifs horizontal scroll 680/356, whatsapp-float visible, 0 horizontal overflow at all breakpoints). ESLint now clean. No blocking bugs found; only minor UI/design nits.

ui_bugs.issue: Sections have no scroll-margin-top, so the fixed 68-76px header covers the top of each section after an anchor click (e.g. clicking 'Services' scrolls to y=1002 which equals section top, hiding the 'NOS SERVICES' eyebrow/heading on mobile). Add scroll-mt-24 (or CSS scroll-padding-top on html) to #services/#flotte/#zones/#tarifs/#contact.

Still unfixed from iteration 1: title1 and title2 joined by
with no whitespace -> accessible/SEO text reads 'Votre chauffeurd'exception' (EN 'Your exceptionalchauffeur', ES 'Tu choferexcepcional').
On mobile the fixed float still overlaps content (covers the Fleet '5 places' badge and part of the last footer/supplement line). Add bottom padding to Footer/last section or raise the offset.

No data-testid on the section or its 6 items, so it cannot be asserted directly by automation (had to detect it by background colour). Add data-testid="advantages-section" / "advantage-item-{i}". Same for Zones chips (only the wrapper zones-list has one).

issues: Section heading block is left-aligned while Zones/Tarifs/Advantages headings are centered - inconsistent rhythm between blocks.
Still uses native browser date/time inputs (US mm/dd/yyyy placeholder in non-FR browsers) instead of a locale-aware/shadcn-style picker.
No min attribute on the date input: a past pickup date can be submitted.

Table scrolls horizontally (scrollWidth 680 vs client 356); the Voiture/Van price columns are entirely off-screen on first paint, only the '<- Destination ->' hint suggests scrolling. A stacked card layout would read better.
Slide dots are only 6px tall (below the 24-44px touch-target guidance) - fine with a mouse, cramped on touch.

action_items: Add scroll-margin-top (scroll-mt-24) to #services/#flotte/#zones/#tarifs/#contact so anchor navigation does not hide headings behind the fixed navbar.
Add a space (or aria-label) between hero title1 and title2 - accessible name is still 'Votre chauffeurd'exception'.
Add data-testid to the Advantages section/items and to individual Zones chips for testability.
Optional: min={today} on the wizard date input; locale-aware date/time picker; mobile card layout for Tarifs; extra bottom padding so the WhatsApp float does not overlap footer/fleet badges.
critical_code_review_comments: ReservationWizard.handleSubmit still has no try/catch: only a returned supabase `error` is handled. A thrown network/DNS exception would leave status='loading' forever (submit button permanently disabled). Wrap in try/catch/finally.
No client-side format validation on phone/email in the wizard; canProceed() only checks non-empty strings.
AddressAutocomplete calls Nominatim directly from the browser with no identifying header/rate-limit guard (usage-policy risk in production) and silently keeps stale suggestions when res.ok is false.
Fleet.tsx / ReservationWizard.tsx type the i18n function as `t: (k: any) => string` - use the translation key union type instead of any (lint passes only because the rule is now off/warn).
useBuildWhatsAppMessage and useBuildEmailBody are ~90% duplicated (DRY) - extract a single formatter.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of functional flows passed (0 blocking failures)

seed_data_creation: None - wizard filled with throwaway data (Jean Dupont / 0612345678); no persistence (placeholder Supabase).
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present - not needed (public site, #/admin out of scope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test on http://localhost:3000 (external URL behind Cloudflare). Verified working in iteration 2: dark hero bg rgb(10,10,10); hero imgs all naturalWidth 1600; slide dots switch vehicle name; navbar bg rgba(10,10,10,0.6) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.9) after 420px; wizard step gating + Nominatim suggestions (selector 'ul li button'); placeholder-Supabase submit shows 'Une erreur est survenue...' red box then button returns to 'Envoyer ma reservation'; context header = <h2 'Reserver votre taxi'> following-sibling p; mobile menu link selector must be `header a[href="#services"]`.last (desktop copy exists but is hidden); reveal 7/7 visible after full scroll; overflow 0 at 1920/390. ESLint clean. Only console errors are vite HMR websocket ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (harmless).
rca_of_the_issue: Anchor-offset issue: sections are targeted by id with a position:fixed header and no scroll-margin-top, so window.scrollY lands exactly on the section top and the header (68-76px) overlays the heading. Reproduce: 390x844, open mobile menu, tap 'Services' -> 'NOS SERVICES' eyebrow is clipped under the navbar. Fix: add scroll-mt-24 to each section (or html { scroll-padding-top: 5rem }).
